evals.prompt: I have a normal digital PDF with selectable text. Produce a safe full-text copy beside it without changing the original.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper chooses mode none, creates the four output artifacts, and preserves the input hash.
expectations: Runs scripts/ocr_pdf.ps1 with an explicit language list.
The input PDF is not overwritten.

evals.prompt: This PDF is a one-page scan with simplified Chinese and English. Make it searchable and give me its complete text.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper chooses mode skip and returns a searchable PDF plus full text extracted from the completed PDF.
expectations: Uses an explicit language list selected by a one-page sample; the current generated canary starts with chi_sim.
The final text comes from pdftotext -layout, not OCRmyPDF sidecar.

evals.prompt: Pages 1-2 are native digital text and page 3 is an image scan. Convert it to one searchable PDF without losing the original text pages.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper chooses mode skip and the output text contains known samples from both the original text pages and OCR page.
expectations: Document-level mixed content uses skip rather than redo.
Output page count and geometry match input.
Full text includes digital and OCR pages.

evals.prompt: This page has a small visible header plus a large scanned document image. Rebuild its text layer safely.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper classifies the page as page_mixed and uses mode redo.

evals.prompt: This scanned PDF already has a good searchable text layer. Extract the full text but do not OCR it again.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper chooses mode none and publishes a copied PDF with extracted text.
expectations: Output PDF hash equals the input PDF hash.
No OCRmyPDF engine call is needed.

evals.prompt: The PDF looks like a scan, but copied text is replacement characters and mojibake. Rebuild the damaged OCR layer.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper identifies the damaged layer and uses mode redo, then validates the final PDF.
expectations: Obvious replacement characters or control/private-use mappings route to redo.
Final PDF opens with PyMuPDF, Poppler, and strict pypdf.
Failure leaves no official output names.
